summary: Create A Quality Inspection Lot Automatically Upon Goods Receipt For G
businessObject: Quality Inspection Lot, Goods Receipt, Quality Inspection Stock

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Manage Inspection Lots" Fiori app.
An inspection lot is automatically generated when goods receipt is posted for materials flagged with a quality inspection type in the material master.
The received stock is automatically posted to Quality Inspection stock and is not available for unrestricted use or production consumption.
The inspector can record results of physical/chemical tests against the inspection characteristics defined in the inspection plan.
The system allows Usage Decision (UD) recording — Accept, Reject, or Conditional Accept.
Upon "Accept" UD, the stock is automatically transferred from Quality Inspection to Unrestricted-Use stock.
Upon "Reject" UD, the stock is transferred to Blocked stock and cannot be issued to production.
The system maintains a complete audit trail of inspection results and UD decisions for regulatory traceability.

HP.description: Post GR for QM-active material → inspection lot auto-created → stock posted to Quality Inspection → record test results (all within spec) → record Accept UD → stock transferred to Unrestricted-Use → verify audit trail

AP.description: Post GR for QM-active material → inspection lot auto-created → record test results → record Reject UD → stock transferred to Blocked
Post GR for QM-active material → inspection lot auto-created → record test results → record Conditional Accept UD → stock transferred to Unrestricted-Use with restriction note

NEG.description: Post GR for material WITHOUT QM inspection type configured → no inspection lot created, stock posted directly to Unrestricted-Use
Attempt to issue material from Quality Inspection stock to production (without UD) → system rejects
Attempt to issue material from Blocked stock to production (after Reject UD) → system rejects

ERR.description: Missing Inspection Lot Number (system generation failure)
Missing Test Result entry for mandatory characteristic
Missing Usage Decision before attempting to close inspection lot

EDGE.description: Test result value exactly at lower specification limit
Test result value exactly at upper specification limit
Test result value outside specification range (out-of-spec) → system should flag and enforce Reject or Conditional Accept UD

INT.description: Post Goods Receipt via "Post Goods Receipt" Fiori app for QM-active material → verify inspection lot auto-created in "Manage Inspection Lots" app
